body.speaker: agent
body.text: That happens a lot. Open Settings and tap Battery to see what's using it.

body.text: It says the screen.

body.speaker: agent
body.text: Turn the brightness down and set the screen to turn off after 30 seconds.

body.text: Okay, I did that.

body.text: You can also turn on Battery Saver in the same menu.

body.text: Press the top button on the left side of the phone a few times while it's not on a call.

body.text: That's the ring volume. You can also pick a louder ringtone under Settings, then Sound.

body.text: Have someone call you to test it.

body.text: I will. Thanks.
